title: Dereth Town Tour - Ahurenga scratch

shots.standingOrder: Skim 3 m over the open sea toward the reed-ringed village of Ahurenga and its stone spire, slowing to a hover before the first reeds.
shots.notes: WATER (drone.terrain-skim). 3 m over the open sea north-west of the village along a 98 m path heading SSE, easing to rest before the first reeds; the reed-ringed swamp island with its stone spire grows ahead, noon sun high in the east glittering on the water. 100 % over sea (z 0), nearest reed 30 m. shots.standingOrder: Corkscrew up around the Hea stone spire and the purple energy funnel crowning it, widening from 27 to 40 m and staying above the 14 m ferns.

shots.standingOrder: Lie at the foot of the Hea totem poles beside the smouldering brazier and look up past the flames to the totems and the spire against the sky.
